name: kpca_epi_umap
source: KPCA.B tumour (epithelial) cells, 12,429; epithelial UMAP epi_umap_1/2 of the handoff object (models/kpca_mouse 27b, 33). Polarization = SecB − SecA UCell on the mouse 1:1 orthologues of the 7 + 7 signature (maxRank 1500, log-normalised), recomputed as in figures/figure3/04_...; Krt7 from the log-normalised matrix. Ranges are the figure's colour limits (±99th percentile of |polarization|; 0 to 99th percentile of Krt7). y increases upward.
